name: story-writer-runtime
title_zh: 写长篇前先立人物档案和伏笔账本的故事引擎
tagline_zh: 写到第八章忘了配角眼睛什么颜色、埋的钩子忘了收？它先把人物档案、时间线、伏笔账本落成文件，每写一章回头核对。
tagline_en: Chapter eight and you forgot your side character's eye color, or which hook you planted? It writes character.
why_zh: 状态存在文件里而不是上下文里，所以跨几十章也不漂移；伏笔未收会被点名，不是靠你记性。
why_en: State lives in files, not in context, so it survives dozens of chapters; unresolved hooks get called out instead of relying on.
limit_zh: 它管的是长篇连贯性，不管文笔好坏和灵感；短篇三千字以内用它纯属加负担。需要你自己定世界观和主线，它只负责记账和查漏。
limit_en: Built for long-form continuity, not prose quality or ideas; overkill under 3k words. You supply the world and plot—it only keeps the books.
